name: Yanase Momoe
source: A heroine. She attends a private girl's school (the same as Shimizu's) and carries a lady - like aura. Yanase had done ballet for a long time, and won many awards. She is quite proud of her flexible body thanks to ballet. She is now in the rhythmic gymnastic club. A very kind girl, with gentle and mild personality. Very considerate. Yanase is so polite, she even says thanks to the examiner (who looked at her naked and made her do embarrassing things)
